The Ottoman Empire stood between the West and the East, thus blocking the land route eastward and forcing Spanish and Portuguese navigators to set sail in search of a new route to the Orient. Over 60% of Norway's population died in 1348–50. The last plague outbreak ravaged Oslo in 1654.
